title: 31 种电影观感 · 样品图库
note: 独立生成的视觉参考，并非 Studiova 后台样张。每种风格只是一种解读；静态图不代表视频动作、剪辑或音效。

samples.prompt: Create a single photorealistic 9:16 vertical cinematic style reference photograph. This is the AUTO / AI DECIDES baseline for a comparison series. Invent one adult female fashion model about 30, dark chin-length bob hair, natural face, cream long-sleeve blouse tucked into burgundy wide-leg trousers, plain black small shoulder bag. She stands in three-quarter full-length view in the doorway of a retro corner cafe on a city street, one hand loosely holding the bag strap, looking slightly beside camera, thoughtful neutral expression. Pale tiled cafe frontage, warm amber interior through glass, pavement with subtle after-rain reflections. Clean balanced modern cinematic realism, neutral readable skin and outfit, restrained warm/cool separation, ordinary dusk, medium focal length, coherent anatomy. Show head to shoes with room around subject. No text, captions, typography, brands or watermark. No collage. Baseline should be natural and not excessively stylized; later samples will change light/composition/grading but keep this same identity, outfit and location.
samples.name: AI Decides
samples.features: 平衡曝光、自然色彩、适度景深
